meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装上后，当你说“/learn”并给出一个来源（如文件夹、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才一起做的事），Claude 会把这个来源整理成一个可复用的“技能”，生成 SKILL.md 文件存入 .claude/skills 目录；若已有同名技能，则就地更新而非新建。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn”、“learn this”、“make a skill from <来源>”等指令，或要求把文件夹、网址、笔记、刚才的操作变成技能时触发。

say.note: Claude 会读取该文件夹并生成新技能。
Claude 会抓取网页并整理成技能。

say.text: 改进一下咱们的部署技能
say.note: Claude 会读取现有技能并就地更新。

howto.what_en: After install, saying "/learn" with a source (folder, URL, notes, or recent work) makes Claude distill it into a reusable skill, writing SKILL.md under .claude/skills; an existing skill of that name gets updated in place rather than replaced.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/learn", "learn this", "make a skill from <source>", or ask to turn a folder, URL, notes, or the recent work into a skill.

say_en.note: Claude reads the folder and creates a skill.
Claude fetches the page and turns it into a skill.
Claude reads the existing skill and updates it in place.
